title: Sequential Restoring Divider

forbidden.message: no / or % operators: build the restoring algorithm
no /, mod or rem: build the restoring algorithm

constraints: Unsigned 16 / 16 division, **one quotient bit per clock**, with exact timing: the edge E₀ sampling `start` while idle latches the operands. `busy = 1` after E₀ … E₁₅. After E₁₆: `busy = 0`, `done = 1` for one cycle, with `quotient` and `remainder` valid.
Division by zero (natural result of the restoring algorithm): `quotient = 16'hFFFF`, `remainder = dividend`.
`start` is ignored while busy. Results hold until the next division completes. Synchronous reset clears the outputs.
hints: Restoring division: shift the partial remainder left by one, bringing in the next dividend bit (MSB first). Try subtracting the divisor.
If the result is non-negative, keep it and shift a 1 into the quotient. Otherwise keep the old remainder and shift in a 0.
Use a 17-bit subtraction so you can see the sign of `rem - divisor` in the extra bit.
